hooks.command: filepath="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH$TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; if echo "$filepath" | grep -qE '(^|/).env$'; then echo 'BLOCK: .env は手動で編集してください'; exit 2; fi
filepath="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH$TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; if [ -n "$filepath" ] && echo "$filepath" | grep -q '.py$'; then uv run ruff check --fix -q "$filepath"; uv run ruff format -q "$filepath"; fi
if [ -f ".pre-commit-config.yaml" ] && ! [ -f "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/hooks/pre-commit" ]; then uv run pre-commit install --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type post-checkout; fi
hooks.statusMessage: pre-commit フックをインストール中...
